_README: Declare the runtime AI controls YOUR system ACTUALLY has. Do NOT claim controls you haven't implemented — that is falsifying a compliance control. If you don't log inference or cap tokens yet, implement it first, then set these flags.

monitoring._set_true_when: you actually log AI inference activity to a file/DB

anomaly_detection._set_true_when: you have anomaly/drift detection or alerting

_token_note: set a real per-request or daily token cap you actually enforce (e.g. max_tokens); leave 0 if you do not cap tokens
